description: Get Enzo's honest, independent read for one listing: how its price compares to similar homes nearby, price-per-square-foot, days on market, any price cuts, plain caveats, the real monthly cost (mortgage, property tax reassessed at purchase price, insurance, HOA) and the income it takes, AND a forward-looking financial grade (A to F) from a Monte-Carlo of local price dynamics and the rate path versus renting, with a probability and a p10/p50/p90 range. Deterministic, grounded in public data (FRED rates, Zillow ZHVI, state tax rates); a probabilistic model, never a guarantee, a sales pitch, or financial advice. Input is an Enzo's home URL or its id.

home.description: An enzos.ai home URL (…/home/<id>) or the 16-character home id.

title: Home buy verdict
